title: I Want to Steal the Hero’s XX
description:
Won't You Cheat With the Maids?

After defeating the Demon King, the hero Lutz married Princess Perle. Although the two were deeply in love and living a happy life together, Lutz's "thing" was way too big... meaning they could never actually do the deed, leaving him to spend his days pent-up and frustrated.

Then one day, Perle is struck by a mysterious illness that plunges her into an eternal sleep! While Lutz is overcome with grief, his childhood friend and maid, Mia, comes onto him, pressuring him to cheat and start a physical relationship with her!!

Completely backed up from never being able to be intimate with Perle, Lutz finds himself on the verge of caving in to her sweet temptation... What's more, there are other maids trying to have an affair with him too...?!!

Setting aside the one you truly love, won't you let the maids tempt you? A reverse-NTR ecchi fantasy begins!!
author: Kazepana
